independent_recount.method: own Sun position at the edges of 1-minute steps with Saemundsson refraction; mean of 8 calendars 1/8 day apart, centred on day 0 = J2000.0 + 9495.86 days; own spell finding with crossing times inside the minute, joined through midnight and the year end, 120 min minimum; the band sampled every 6 seconds; own polar-stereographic reading of the snow grid; the terrain's open share read from horizon_cells.json
independent_recount.sun_series: Astronomical Almanac low-precision series (the project's), written out again in the program
independent_recount.compared: per cell and target: the six per-bin arrays of grazing_bins.npz (flat, snow_free, open and their long_ twins, by yearly sum and by ten-day bin) and 13 yearly fields of grazing_cells.json, plus the poleward share; and the snow summary of every northern cell
independent_recount.tolerance: the larger of 2 percent and 1 hour a year; or known in one and unknown in the other

calendar_moved.what: every one of the 8 calendars moved 0.14 day later; yearly long-window flat hours of each cell against grazing_bins.npz long_flat
